description: This file defines the StateObserver class, a plugin for the WPEFramework that provides an interface to monitor device state properties and handle JSONRPC communication. It includes constants for system properties, class declarations, method signatures, and event handling mechanisms.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: A plugin class that provides device property monitoring and event notification via JSONRPC, inheriting from PluginHost::IPlugin and PluginHost::JSONRPC.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves current values of specified device properties.

methods.name: registerListeners
methods.description: Registers for notifications on specified device properties.

methods.name: unregisterListeners
methods.description: Unregisters from notifications on specified device properties.

methods.name: setApiVersionNumberWrapper
methods.description: Sets the API version number for the plugin.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumberWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves the current API version number.

methods.name: getRegisteredPropertyNames
methods.description: Gets the list of property names that can be monitored.

methods.name: getVal
methods.description: Helper to get values for a list of property names.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a notification with event name and parameters.

methods.name: setProp
methods.description: Sets a property with specified name, state, and error code.
